settings.heading: FAQ
settings.intro: Quick answers. If your question isn't here, hit us up — the pack answers.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Every Sploot piece is printed to order. Production takes about 2 business days (98% of orders ship within 48 hours), then carrier transit: 7–12 business days within the US, 6–12 across the UK and EU, and up to 30 for the rest of the world. See the shipping page for a full breakdown.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes — the US, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Canada, Australia and most other countries. Shipping options and costs are shown at checkout. Any customs duties or import taxes are the customer's responsibility.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: A tracking number is emailed to you and synced to your account as soon as your order ships. You can follow it in real time at 17track.net.

settings.question: I entered the wrong address — can you fix it?
settings.answer: Email us right away. If your order hasn't entered production we can update it. Once it ships to a wrong or incomplete address, any storage and redelivery costs fall to the customer.

settings.question: My order is really late
settings.answer: Every order is backed by a Delay Compensation Guarantee. If a package runs significantly past its estimate, reach out — depending on the case we'll compensate, reship, or fully refund.

settings.question: How do your tees fit?
settings.answer: Boxy and loose. If you're between sizes, go down for a fitted look or up for oversized.

settings.question: How do the hoodies fit?
settings.answer: Oversized drop-shoulder. Most folks wear their normal size; size down if you want something less roomy.

settings.question: How should I wash my Sploot piece?
settings.answer: Inside out, cold wash, hang dry. Treat the graphic gently and it'll outlive your relationships.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: Because every piece is printed to order, we can't take returns or exchanges for change of mind or sizing — please check the fit notes before ordering.

settings.question: My item arrived damaged or wrong
settings.answer: That's on us. Email us within 14 days of delivery with photos of the item and packaging and we'll replace it or refund you.
